profiles.notes: Direct undergraduate entry and listed alternative qualification routes in the 2026-2027 prospectus.

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · hospitality
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics or Business Studies, and C in English, Kiswahili or a foreign language. A related diploma at Credit pass is an alternative.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 6

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · business technology
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics and English, or two A-level principal passes, or a related diploma at Credit pass or an accepted equivalent.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 6

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · commerce
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics and English, or a related diploma at Credit pass or an accepted equivalent. The programme lists Accounting, Banking and Finance, Technology, Innovation and Entrepreneurship, Finance, Human Resource Management, Insurance, Marketing and Operations Management options.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 7

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · management information
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics and English.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 7

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · economics
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Mathematics, or a related diploma at Credit pass or an accepted equivalent.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 7

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · procurement
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics, or a related diploma at Credit pass or an accepted equivalent.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 7

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · economics finance
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics and English, or a related diploma at Credit pass.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 7

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · agribusiness
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C- in Agriculture, Mathematics and English. The source also lists D+ in Mathematics with C in Commerce and Business Studies as an alternative subject pattern, or a relevant diploma recognized by the University Senate.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 8

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · computer science
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics, Physics and English, or a diploma in Computer Science or Information Technology at Credit pass.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 11

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · information technology
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics or Physics and C in English, or a diploma in Computer Science or Information Technology at Credit pass.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 11

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · telecommunications
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Mathematics and Physics and C in English, or a diploma in Computer Science or Information Technology at Credit pass.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 12

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · actuarial
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with B in Mathematics and C+ in English. KACE or an equivalent Advanced Level qualification with two principal passes, including Mathematics, is an alternative.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 12

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · computer security
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics, or a Computer Science or Information Technology diploma or an accepted equivalent at Credit pass.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 12

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · data science
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Mathematics and English or Kiswahili, or a relevant recognized Data Science, Computer Science, IT or Business IT diploma. The source also accepts the specified Kabarak computing diplomas, KCE/EACE Division II with a qualifying diploma, or Division III with qualifying certificate-to-diploma progression. The KACE route requires two principal passes and one subsidiary.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 12

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · general science
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and Biology. The degree offers Mathematics, Zoology, Botany, Chemistry and Physics specializations.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 13

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · environmental science
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Biology, Chemistry, English and either Physics or Mathematics.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 13

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · education science
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in two teaching subjects and C in Mathematics and English, or two A-level principal passes with one subsidiary, or an Education diploma with KCSE mean C+. Teaching subjects include Mathematics, Physics, Biology, Agriculture, Chemistry and Computer.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 16

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · education arts
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in two teaching subjects, C in English and D+ in Mathematics, or two A-level principal passes with one subsidiary, or an Education diploma with KCSE mean C+. Teaching subjects include English, Literature, History, Music, Geography, CRE and Kiswahili.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 16

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · counselling
requirements.details: Direct-entry alternatives include KCSE mean C+, five IGCSE credits, or two A-level principal passes. A Credit diploma with KCSE mean C and at least two years of relevant practice is another route. The continued row also accepts KCSE mean C- followed by recognized certificate-to-diploma progression.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 16-17

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · agricultural education
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Biology and Agriculture and C in Mathematics or Physics and Chemistry. The source also lists Biological Sciences C+, Agriculture C+ and Mathematics C or Physical Sciences C. A recognized Agricultural Education and Extension diploma or a related discipline is another route, with the stated C+ Biology and Agriculture/Biology background.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 17

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · chaplaincy
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+, or an accepted diploma or equivalent at Credit pass with GPA at least 3.0. The A-level route requires two principal passes at one sitting, or two passes at different sittings with both at grade C or above.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 17

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · theology
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ or a diploma in Theology.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 17

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · health direct
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ and C+ in Biology, Chemistry, English or Kiswahili, and Mathematics or Physics.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 20

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · nutrition
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C in Chemistry or Physical Sciences, Biology or Biological Sciences, English or Kiswahili, and one of Physics, Mathematics or Geography. An ordinary Nutrition and Dietetics or Nutrition and Food Sciences diploma at Credit pass from a recognized institution, with KNDI registration, is an alternative.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 21

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · pharmacy
requirements.details: KCSE mean B- with C+ in Biology, Chemistry, English or Kiswahili, and Mathematics or Physics. A Pharmaceutical Technology diploma with KCSE mean C+ and enrolment with the Pharmacy and Poisons Board is an alternative.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 24

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · law
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with B in English or Kiswahili.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 24

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · music production
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Music, or KCSE mean C+ with ABRSM Grade 5 Theory and/or Practical. Other routes include KCSE mean C- with a recognized Music diploma, KCSE mean D with certificate-to-diploma progression, or an accepted Music diploma. One A-level principal pass at one sitting, or two principal passes at different sittings, is another route. Applicants with KCSE mean C+ and substantial music production aptitude can qualify through standard auditions.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 26

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · music composition
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in Music, or KCSE mean C+ with ABRSM Grade 5 Theory and/or Practical. Other routes include KCSE mean C- with a recognized Music diploma, KCSE mean D with certificate-to-diploma progression, or an accepted Music diploma. The continued row adds one A-level principal pass at one sitting or two principal passes at different sittings, or KCSE mean C+ with substantial performance or composition aptitude established at a standard audition.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 26-27

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · film theatre
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in English or Kiswahili or an equivalent in another system. Alternatives include KCSE mean C- with a recognized KNQA Level 6 diploma in Film, Theatre, Mass Media or a related area, KCSE mean D+ with recognized KNQA Level 5 certificate-to-Level 6 diploma progression, or an accepted Film or Theatre diploma.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 27

requirements.label: Undergraduate entry · mass communication
requirements.details: KCSE mean C+ with C+ in English or Kiswahili, or a Journalism and Mass Communication or Public Relations diploma at Credit pass. The course lists Media and Public Relations options.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · entry requirements · pp. 27

profiles.notes: Professional in-service applicants to the listed health programmes.

requirements.label: In-service admission · Nursing
requirements.details: KCSE mean C or KCE Division II, at least two years of relevant experience after graduation as a registered nurse, and a valid practising licence.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · in-service requirements · pp. 20

requirements.label: In-service admission · Public Health
requirements.details: KCSE mean C and a diploma in Environmental Health or Public Health.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · in-service requirements · pp. 21

requirements.label: In-service admission · Human Nutrition and Dietetics
requirements.details: KCSE mean C, a Nutrition and Dietetics diploma and KNDI registration.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · in-service requirements · pp. 21

requirements.label: In-service admission · Medical Laboratory Sciences
requirements.details: A Medical Laboratory Technology diploma with KCSE mean C and C in each mandatory subject, plus KMLTTB registration.

source.title: Kabarak prospectus 2026-2027 · in-service requirements · pp. 21
